verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents API and CLI (pspace) for creating machines, choosing GPU types, and managing templates/auto-shutdown, and API keys enable programmatic access (paperspace-docs-1,6,23,24,30). However, there is no documented API/CLI call for explicit teardown/deletion, no monitoring/status endpoint, and no MCP server integration; community reports (paperspace-comm-7) describe SSH access as 'an uphill battle' with a 'pointless virtual console,' undermining the claim of frictionless headless access. Missing for 10: explicit delete/teardown API or CLI command, monitoring/telemetry API, MCP server support, and independent confirmation of full non-human lifecycle automation.
